node.title: Re^2: system() call mis-directs?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
quotemeta($sensor)

Sorry, but [doc://quotemeta] is not an appropriate shell quoting function - it may work in some cases, but will fail in others. I would strongly recommend e.g. [mod://ShellQuote::Any] instead, or of course to [id://1180578|avoid the shell] in the first place.
